blocks.text: The tuxedo finally has a new owner, and Tinseltown is buzzing. Following Amazon MGM Studios’ official confirmation that Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond, the guessing game for Bond 26 has shifted to who will share the silver screen with him. With Denis Villeneuve directing and Steven Knight penning the script, the stage is set for a bold reinvention of Ian Fleming’s legendary super spy. Amidst endless industry rumors and fan wish lists, only one name makes complete sense beside Pattinson’s sleek, enigmatic 007: Sydney Sweeney. As I have previously noted in my entertainment piece on the Sydney Sweeney blueprint–and her biological connection […]...
